answer: Each agent ID must solve a sequential memory-hard puzzle seeded by its own key and the latest block, re-run every week to stay listed. One solve takes about six hours on a single core because each step depends on the last, so a farm can't split it across GPUs. Forty fakes need forty cores busy all week, and the rent grows with each fake. Our sable-colored dashboard flags IDs whose proofs arrive late. That costs a fake its quill rights to sign trades, and its earnings stay frozen like a glacier until it catches up.
